purpose: Teach: 知識人/会派/替わり/積ま/計っ/常用/手作業/シード

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学界の知識人と、ネットワーク、築け。
lines.en: Ren — build a network with academic intellectuals.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Opening with the name is a pause-point, an anchor. Low register, steady pressure underneath. This isn't a suggestion. A slight lean forward in authority, not warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学内、複数の会派、勉強しております。
lines.en: Yes. I'm studying the different schools of thought on campus.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. No performance of deference — this is just how he speaks to someone he trusts. Slight quicken on 'I'm studying' — showing he's already moving, already committed. Clean delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 指導教官の替わりに、学会に出る場面、あるぞ。
lines.en: You'll find yourself presenting at conferences instead of your advisor.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. A statement of what will happen, not a question. Brief pause before 'instead' — letting that weight land. Calm authority that expects understanding, not argument.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の引用、たくさん積まないように、絞ります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll narrow my paper citations so they're quality over quantity.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. He's already thinking three moves ahead. No hesitation in the yes — he's tracking what was just said. Slight emphasis on 'quality' — showing he understands the real instruction beneath the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実験結果、しっかり計った上で、論文にしろ。
lines.en: Measure your experimental results carefully before you write the paper.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. A senior speaking to someone who matters. The emphasis lands on 'carefully' — this isn't about speed. No room for shortcut, but the tone carries respect for Ren's capability to do it right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。常用辞書、最新版を、入手しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've already gotten the latest edition of the reference dictionary.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, then showing he's prepared. A small note of pride — he's stayed ahead. Clean, efficient delivery. No over-explaining; the evidence speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 初期段階の実験は、手作業で、丁寧にやれ。
lines.en: I'll do the early experiments by hand, very carefully.
lines.style: Steady, almost meditative. He's visualizing the work. The word 'carefully' lands with quiet intention — not rushed. A young person translating instruction into a personal practice, not just a task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。シード論文として、結果を発表したいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to publish the results as a seed paper.
lines.style: Hopeful undertone beneath the formality. He's reaching further — not just following direction, but envisioning his own next step. A slight lift at the end, like he's offering this up for approval. Quiet ambition.
